title: Rabbi David Tawil: Life Lessons From Pirke Abot- "Enjoying the Journey"

chapters.title: The Jewish perspective on the human being
chapters.about: Contrasting extreme views of humanity with the balanced Jewish approach

chapters.about: Unfinished missions, effort-based reward, and starting Torah anew

summary: Rabbi Tawil connects the tragic ending of the Torah with the death of Moshe Rabenu to the teachings of Pirkei Avot, addressing how people feel after the holidays conclude. He explains that human beings are a balance of physical and spiritual elements, and that people are not required to complete every goal in life as long as they put in their best effort. The class emphasizes that the journey and process of studying Torah and growing are what matter most.
questions: Why does the Torah end with the death of Moshe Rabbenu when his mission was unfulfilled?
How does Judaism view the nature of human beings compared to extreme philosophies?
Why do we not know where Moshe Rabbenu is buried?
What does Pirkei Avot teach us about our origins and future judgment?
How does the concept of effort versus results apply to studying Torah?
